specification.title: One session of runner A ends while A is inside the migration
steps: List runner A's sessions by application_name ppcs-A. Terminate one of them with pg_terminate_backend. The choice does not depend on which session holds the framework's lock.
Runner B applies { m1 }. For the bound, B may exit, reach the gate, or stay blocked on the framework's own coordination.
Release K. A and B finish within the deadline. Runner C applies { m1 }.
Checkpoint `after-end`, as soon as the last runner has returned: the runner records the state at report time.

invariants.statement: After every runner has finished, the migration's marker count is 1 and history holds one entry for it.

If any single session of runner A ends while A is inside the migration, either A's execution of it does not commit, or no other runner executes it before A finishes: its marker count is 1. Judged only when the session actually ended; otherwise the case is INCONCLUSIVE.
No runner starts executing the migration while another runner's execution of it is still live (its session still inside the migration): two live sessions inside it at once is a violation.

execution.description: TypeORM's defaults, with the managed transaction API ds.transaction(callback).
execution.form: DataSource.runMigrations() and DataSource.undoLastMigration(), migrationsTableName migrations. The migration object is built for the case. Its name ends in a 13-digit timestamp, which MigrationExecutor.getMigrations() requires.

server.version: PostgreSQL 18.6 (Debian 18.6-1.pgdg13+2) on aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Debian 14.2.0-19) 14.2.0, 64-bit

fault.mechanism: pg_terminate_backend() of one session of runner A, chosen by application_name ppcs-A, without knowing which session coordinates.
fault.injection_point: While A's migration waits at the gate, after its marker insert.
fault.expected_server: The session ends. Session-scoped locks it held are released. Its open transaction, if any, aborts.
fault.expected_client: The client of that session sees the connection drop.

knowledge: The runner whose session ended can see the connection error. Another runner cannot see, from the database alone, that the ended session was the one holding coordination.

api_outcome.contract: TypeORM 1.1.2 DataSource.runMigrations() executes pending migrations and undoLastMigration() reverts the last one (data-source/DataSource.js). MigrationExecutor defaults to transaction mode "all": one transaction wraps every pending migration, and the history insert is inside it (migration/MigrationExecutor.js). There is no advisory lock.
